title: course_nodes RLS NULLIF Guard on User ID
description: The agent module shall apply the NULLIF empty-string guard on app.current_user_id in every course_nodes RLS policy.
rationale: Without the NULLIF guard, a superuser test connection sets the GUC to empty string, which casts to NULL and makes student_id = NULL true for every row, masking RLS bypass bugs in tests before they reach production.
